plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Connect/Disconnect Spotify has moved from the main kiosk screen into the plugin's Settings page and is now admin-only, so students and teachers using the kiosk can no longer sign in or out of Spotify themselves - they can still browse, search and add tracks using the connection an admin sets up once. Press and hold a teacher playlist button to pop up a QR code linking to that playlist (paste a "Share > Invite collaborators" link per row in Settings for the exact invite link; otherwise it falls back to the playlist's normal share link). Settings can now also sync the Teacher Playlists list against whatever playlists are actually visible in the connected Spotify account, automatically adding new ones and removing ones that disappear, both on connect and via a new "Sync Playlists Now" button.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
